question: What do indexed acquisition, equal-bits scalar state and simple hash controls actually cost as public-key history grows?

evidence_gate.inherited: Fixed-expert routing in DEV055/056 is not C5; synthetic lookup mechanisms reusable
evidence_gate.new_L2: Dependency-directed acquisition, collision/overwrite handling, exact fixed-state bit budgets and complete build/read/write accounting
evidence_gate.new_L3: Exact latest-fact circuit answers versus work curves
evidence_gate.not_claimed: Learned retrieval advantage, memory novelty, trained CASM-S discovery or full TAC-OSM C5 superiority

benchmark: Four public write epochs over H/4 entity keys, each independently shuffled. Query requests latest values of8 distinct public keys, then executes seven public XOR nodes on those8 bits. Gold latest-state answers evaluator-only; acquisition receives public keys and writes. Stale facts/collisions cannot silently count as correct.
capacity: Scalar, direct hash and two-way hash each own exactly64 records of3int32 fields: public key,last tick,bit;768bytes=6144bits, validity via key=-1. No external retained lookup/index/history. Full scan and unbounded indexed acquisition retain public history/latest map and are NOT capacity-matched. Report serialized payload and Python resident container estimate separately.
costs: Charge every public write in one-time build, all key comparisons/slot reads, index writes and actual seven-node execution. Indexed build traverses all H events. Report total build+queries amortized by Q; index addressing operations and record probes separately. No flat-query-cost interpretation without build/storage cost.
metrics: Primary exact circuit success AND all8 facts present/current; missing input forces abstention even if guessed XOR would match. Report coverage, stale/collision failures, writes/comparisons/read probes, payload bytes, Python resident estimate and descriptive elapsed time. Finite64-record state is not assumed to preserve unbounded history.
decision: Bounded indexing mechanism only if indexed/full-scan exact success1 in EVERY cell, index build reads H, indexed probes per query8 and full-scan probes grow with H. No TAC-OSM efficiency claim from a hand-coded public-key lookup benchmark.
audit: Separate process regenerates every cell and exact output/work/bytes/manifest, excluding timings. Adversarial overwrite, collisions and absent-key tests. All cells preserved.
next: Future learned acquisition must use nontrivial relevance, matched TOTAL storage, full update/build costs and actual learned CASM execution. This study has no learned challenger and cannot close C5.
budget: 3seeds x4H x3Q x5arms=180cells, queries share prefixes and are not independent. No fitting/paid compute. One full matrix plus deterministic replay. Tests8571xxx disjoint.
